title: Bench Bridge demo: older lab instruments feed a LIMS
headline: Older lab instruments feed the LIMS and the ledger
description: Demo with sample data. It shows how older lab instruments can feed a laboratory information management system (LIMS) and controlled-substance ledgers.
summary: Bench Bridge is a demo with sample data. It shows how older lab instruments can feed a laboratory information management system (LIMS) and controlled-substance ledgers.
needsScript: This demo needs JavaScript to run.
shows: Each demo instrument has a concept drawing, a port, a bridge kit, sample readings and a delivery step.
The LIMS and the ledger in the demo are mock systems. The ledger resets on each page load.
The demo runs in the browser. It has no login.
limits: All data is sample data. No real instrument, sample or ledger connects to the demo.
Drawings and kits are concept. They are not to scale and they are not dimensioned.
Kit parts are example parts. A part name is not an endorsement.
The bridge is designed to support validation. The demo makes no claim of regulatory compliance.
